analysis:
Examined both test files' complete supplied BASE/HEAD source, patches and metadata against the definition index and detailed T-041 cache contract. No concrete security regression is supported by these test-only changes. SSDShorterCheckpointRestoreTests.swift:307-348 now parks the replacement read independently, verifies that old same-ID work cannot erase its registration, and opens both gates on failure. It retains assertions that old work cannot retry or publish and only the replacement stages. Surrounding tests retain bounded retry, authenticated-corruption rejection, cancellation/epoch/close fences, scratch retirement and reservation-refund checks relevant to TB-007, T-041 and A-001. SSDWholeRootTelemetryConcurrencyTests.swift:17 only adds unusedSince to a private test double's method signature; deletion remains under its mutation barrier and safe-path helper (19-30). The heartbeat snapshot availability oracle remains unchanged (65-79). Ignoring the cutoff in this paused test double is not evidence that production ignores TTL.
Integration must verify the corresponding production shared-read lease and registration-ownership implementation in SSDHybridCheckpointStore/file coordination, including exclusive deletion versus active reads and independent reservation retirement. It must also verify the new SSDEvictableStore unusedSince contract across real stores and whole-root maintenance so refreshed entries are not incorrectly expired and the T-041 sliding TTL remains bounded. Those implementations and test execution results are outside this supplied scope; tests alone do not establish these material cross-file properties. No changed authorization, attestation, transport encryption, billing, privileged-helper or installer behavior appears here.
